title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 5: Solomon's agreement with Hiram of Tyre and the preparations to build the house of Yahweh.

questions.text: Who was Hiram, who sent his servants to Solomon?
questions.explanation: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had always loved David.

questions.text: Why, according to Solomon, could David not build a house for Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: Solomon said David could not build the house because of the wars which were around him on every side.

answers.text: Because he did not have enough gold
Because of the wars around him on every side
Because the people refused to work
Because he had no cedar wood

questions.text: Solomon said no one among his people could cut timber like whom?
questions.explanation: Solomon wrote that there was nobody among them who knew how to cut timber like the Sidonians.

questions.text: What did Hiram say when he heard Solomon's words?
questions.explanation: Hiram rejoiced greatly and said, "Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people."

answers.text: "Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son"
"I will not send my servants to the land of Israel"
"Let Solomon first pay me in silver and gold"
"Tyre and Sidon will serve Israel forever"

questions.text: How did Hiram plan to bring the timber to the place Solomon chose?
questions.explanation: Hiram's servants would bring the timber down from Lebanon to the sea and make it into rafts to go by sea.

answers.text: With camel caravans through the desert
Carried by slaves over the mountains

questions.text: What did Solomon give Hiram year by year?
questions.explanation: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for his household and twenty cors of pure oil, year by year.

questions.text: What did Hiram and Solomon make together?
questions.explanation: There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

answers.text: A new city by the sea

questions.text: How was the time of the levy of workers divided?
questions.explanation: Solomon sent them to Lebanon ten thousand a month by courses: a month in Lebanon and two months at home.

answers.text: Two months in Lebanon and one month at home
One month in Lebanon and two months at home
One week in Lebanon and one week at home

questions.text: Who was over the men subject to forced labor?
questions.explanation: The levy was sent to Lebanon in courses, and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

questions.text: What were the large, costly stones cut for?
questions.explanation: The king commanded, and they cut out large, costly stones to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

answers.text: To build the wall of Jerusalem
To lay the foundation of the house
To make the altar of burnt offering
